name: cluster-by-frequency
description:
The cluster of each phrase: its words that stand in at least a number of phrases of the core.

threshold: the fewest phrases a word must stand in to name a cluster.

A word counts once per phrase; words are compared in any case and with ё as е; stopwords are left out. The cluster lists its words in lower case, the most frequent first, then alphabetically, so «купить диван» and «диван купить» make one cluster. A phrase with no such word gets an empty cell.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "диван купить" --text "купить кресло" cluster-by-frequency 2 write -
-> купить диван, купить диван; диван купить, купить диван; купить кресло, купить

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_cluster.

options.name: --threshold
options.description: the fewest phrases a word must stand in to name a cluster.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: THRESHOLD
arguments.description: the fewest phrases a word must stand in to name a cluster. The same as --threshold THRESHOLD.
